title: Removing Service Parts makes the Service Labor person the one rep
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A customer has representatives for service labor, service parts and part sales, and you remove the service parts one.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s Edit Customer window is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  2. Save the customer and look at its page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Service Parts goes away; the first field is renamed "Sales Representative" and reads {Sales-rep-A}; "Sales Representative - Part Sales" still reads {Sales-rep-C}.
  • Step 2: the page shows "Sales Representative" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R11: “Removing Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative" again. It keeps the Service Labor person, who becomes the customer's one representative for labor and parts. A Part Sales field, if added, keeps its choice.”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
